cameras.name: SF Bar Buoy (offshore, NDBC 46026)
cameras.notes: VERIFIED LIVE (2026-07-04): example frame https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/images/buoycam/W49A_2026_07_05_0410.jpg returned 200, image/jpeg, ~34KB, ~50min old at fetch. Filename encodes internal buoy ID (W49A for station 46026) + UTC timestamp (YYYY_MM_DD_HHMM), so there is NO static 'latest.jpg' -- must scrape buoycam.php?station=46026 (or station_page.php) each poll to discover the current filename, then fetch that. Daylight-only (real camera, not IR), roughly hourly cadence. This is a literal sea-level photo 18nm west of the Golden Gate -- genuinely different vantage than satellite (surface-level marine layer check). embed.kind set to 'link' rather than 'image' because src is not stable; a build-time or client-side script would need to resolve the current image URL first. Other NDBC stations with buoycams exist too (e.g. 46013 Bodega Bay, 46042 Monterey) -- same pattern, worth enumerating if more sea-level angles wanted.

cameras.name: Sunset State Beach (Monterey Bay)
cameras.notes: VERIFIED LIVE (2026-07-04): c1_snap.jpg returned 200, valid JPEG (~313KB, FFD8FFE0 header). Site slug 'sunset' = Sunset State Beach, Watsonville CA, ~15mi south of Santa Cruz / Monterey Bay -- NOT SF Bay proper, judgment call on geographic scope but it's the ONLY other live USGS CoastCam site anywhere near us. c2_snap.jpg (camera 2, looking north per USGS description) very likely also exists but wasn't independently fetched. URL SCHEME (confirmed): https://cmgp-coastcam.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/cameras/<site-slug>/latest/c<N>_snap.jpg where N=1,2,3... per camera head at that site. Bucket root listing is BLOCKED (403, no public XML index) so enumeration must be by confirming known slugs from USGS's own program page, not by browsing S3. Exhaustively checked: no other CoastCam sites exist anywhere near Pacifica, Ocean Beach/SF, Point Reyes, Half Moon Bay, Marin, or North Bay -- rest of the national network is Atlantic (MA, Puerto Rico), Alaska, and Gulf (FL), irrelevant to us. Only 'dreaminn' (already in cameras.json) and 'sunset' (this entry) are Pacific-coast-relevant.

cameras.name: Point Reyes Beach
cameras.attribution: National Park Service, Air Resources Division
cameras.notes: VERIFIED LIVE (2026-07-04): 200 OK image/jpeg, fresh timestamp, refreshes ~every 15min. Part of NPS ARD's national air-quality webcam network (same program used at other parks for visibility monitoring) -- direct first-party NPS image, not a third-party link-out. View looks north-northeast from the lighthouse visitor center area toward Point Reyes Beach. Coords are approximate (lighthouse visitor center vicinity, ~38.0223/-122.9728) -- NPS doesn't publish exact camera mount coordinates. type set to 'satellite' per instructions (standardized gov still-image vendor bucket) though it's a plain webcam, not orbital -- flag for a human to reconsider if a dedicated 'nps' type is preferred later. GGNRA itself (nps.gov/goga) has NO NPS-operated cameras -- their webcams page only links third parties we may already have or could add separately: Fort Funston (flyfunston.org, already in our set), Muir Beach (sigward.com, already in our set), Mt Tam (rntl.net -- different from our existing ABC7 Mt Tam cam, could be a second angle), Stinson Beach (webcoos.org). Alcatraz cam confirmed OFFLINE. Muir Woods confirmed NO webcam exists.
